title: tc-person-links
description:
The people linked to a person or an account, each with their role, a second line and how strong the link is,
selectable to open them.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

people.description: The people, in the order given

selected.description: The selected person's id. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

max.description: How many rows show before "Show all"; unset shows everyone

expanded.description: Shows everyone past `max`; the "Show all" button toggles it

networkLabel.description: The header action's label, e.g. "View network"; unset hides it

countLabel.description: What the count says after the number: "6 linked"

strengthLabels.description: The strengths' names, merged over the defaults (Strong, Medium, Weak, Unknown)

detail.description: A second line: an ID, a company, a place

strength.description: How strong the link is; unset is "unknown"

picture.description: A picture URL; without one the row shows the name's initials

tag.description: An extra pill for what matters most about the link, e.g. { label: "Key link", tone: "danger" }
